description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Voucher' which is a controller within the OpenCart admin extension system, specifically for handling total voucher functionalities in the extension system. The class includes methods for displaying the voucher extension page ('index') and saving its configuration ('save'), and relies on various external systems such as language, URL, session, response, and models.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for managing voucher total extension in OpenCart's admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the voucher extension configuration page, prepares breadcrumb navigation, loads styles and scripts, and displays the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of the voucher total extension settings; performs permission check, updates settings, and returns a JSON response.
